Name: Harvest Moon Tools
Author: Degrelescence
Description:
Updates the look of the Pickaxe, Axe, Hoe, Scythe, Gold Scythe, and/or Water Can on the Selection Bar to a much cooler, 3/4 view.
The designs are all based on the same tools in [url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/snes/harvestmoon/sheet/69093/]Harvest Moon for the SNES[/url].
Each tool's change can be turned on or off in the config.

The original mod was [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/401]Tool Icon Replacement[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3071004]workingorder[/url].
Unfortunately workingorder's mod hasn't been updated since 03 October 2016 at 3:34PM and is not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
The new version does work with SMAPI and CP and has a config to chose which tools you want to change!

INSTALLATION
Just unzip and drop the folder into \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
Changing any value from 'Enabled' to 'Disabled' in 'content.json' will revert that tool to its default icon.
